unit.why: A letter from R. Yitzhak Isaac of Zhidachov to R. Yitzhak Yehuda Yehiel of Komarno wishing him recovery, with Zohar and midrash exegesis; nothing happens to anyone in it, so there is no narrative.
unit.boundary_note: first of five letters introduced in the previous division; the next division holds letter (ב)
